item.title: [ZEPPELIN-960] Running Notebooks via REST API broken recently
item.description:
When I try to do a simple POST to run a notebook on the notebook API I get the following exception. The API used to work fine back in commit a63e034ba0fbe860d8ec94a5e164939665bfbcd4 (around April). We recently rebuilt zeppelin from master and the API no longer works, this ought to hopefully narrow down which changes broke it.

+ curl -XPOST http://192.168.99.100:8080/api/notebook/job/2BNQDW1FS

item.summary: Running Notebooks via REST API broken recently

status.description: The issue is considered finished, the resolution is correct. Issues which are not closed can be reopened.

comments.comment: This means we do not have tests for that API, right?
The API is very useful for running notebooks automatically. Is anyone working on this?

We have a workaround for this.

Before we call POST we use the /api/notebook/interpreter/bind/${notebook_id} endpoint to essentially click the "save" button. This used to work just fine, but we realise that now we need to explicitly specify a Content-Type header otherwise it doesn't seem to work (not sure why). Of course a NPE with ST is still a bug.

    curl -H 'Content-Type:application/json' -XPUT -d "${ID_ARRAY}" http://${IP}:${port}/api/notebook/interpreter/bind/${notebook_id}

    echo "INFO: Running notebook: $notebook_id"

    curl -XPOST http://${IP}:${port}/api/notebook/job/${notebook_id}

(Sorry about above formatting, JIRA code blocks suck!)

GitHub user cloverhearts opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1242

ZEPPELIN-960 runNoteJob for notebook rest api modified action when interpreter not binding.
